about: Generated from the Refract Motion source. Everything a .refract.json project file can contain. See README.md for how to use it.

categories.label: Retro
categories.blurb: VHS, CRT, dither, ASCII, pixels, glitch

fieldModes.mode: Limits where the effect shows. Radial is a circle or oval, Ring is a donut, Linear is a soft wipe from one side.
fieldModes.invert: Flips the area: the effect shows everywhere except inside the shape.
fieldModes.center: The middle of the area. Drag the dot on the canvas.
fieldModes.radius: How big the area is (for Linear: how long the wipe is).
fieldModes.feather: How soft the edge of the area is. 0 is a hard edge.
fieldModes.angle: Turns the area (or the wipe direction).
fieldModes.aspect: Stretches the circle into an oval. 1 is a perfect circle.
fieldModes.falloff: The shape of the fade at the edge: Smooth, Linear (even), Sharp (holds then drops) or Soft (very gentle).

modifiers.name: Wiggle
modifiers.description: Smooth random motion around the value.

modifiers.name: Oscillate
modifiers.description: Repeating wave added to the value, with optional decay.

modifiers.name: Loop
modifiers.description: Repeat the keyframed animation after its last keyframe.

effects.name: Liquid Glass
effects.description: Turns the layer into refractive glass that bends, frosts and tints what is behind it.
effects.about: Turns the layer into a piece of clear glass that bends, blurs and tints whatever is behind it. Put it on a shape or text above a photo or video.

params.label: Thickness
params.help: How thick and rounded the glass edge is. Thicker glass has a wider curved rim.

params.label: Refraction
params.help: How much the glass bends what is behind it. Higher is a stronger lens. Negative bends the other way.

params.label: Dispersion
params.help: Rainbow color edges where the glass bends light, like a prism.

params.label: Frost
params.help: Blurs what you see through the glass, like frosted glass.

params.label: Edge softness
params.help: Smooths the curved rim so the bent background looks clean instead of streaky. Lower it for a sharper, more literal lens.

params.label: Tint
params.help: Colors the glass. The color's opacity sets how strong the tint is.

params.label: Brightness
params.help: Makes what you see through the glass lighter or darker.

params.label: Edge light
params.help: A thin bright line of light along the glass edge.

params.label: Specular
params.help: The bright shiny reflection where light hits the glass.

params.label: Shininess
params.help: How small and sharp the shiny reflection is. Higher is a tighter, glossier spot.

params.label: Fresnel
params.help: Makes the edges brighter and more reflective than the middle, like real glass.

params.label: Inner caustic
params.help: A soft glow of light focused inside the glass, on the side away from the light.

params.label: Light angle
params.help: Which direction the light comes from. Moves the reflections and edge light around.

params.label: Show layer
params.help: Mixes the layer's own color back in. 0 is pure clear glass; 100% shows the original layer.

effects.name: Chrome
effects.description: Polished metal with a reflected horizon. Classic chrome type in one tap.
effects.about: Turns the layer into shiny polished metal, like classic chrome lettering.

params.label: Bevel
params.help: How wide the rounded metal edge is.

params.label: Depth
params.help: How deep and curved the metal looks. Higher means stronger reflections on the edges.

params.label: Horizon
params.help: Where the reflected horizon line (sky meets ground) sits on the metal.

params.label: Sharpness
params.help: How crisp the horizon line in the reflection is.

params.label: Ripples
params.help: Adds extra stripes to the reflection for a liquid-metal look. 0 is plain.

params.label: Tint
params.help: Colors the metal: gold, rose, blue steel. The color's opacity sets the strength.

params.label: Reflection turn
params.help: Turns the reflection around, as if rotating the metal under the lights.

params.label: Specular
params.help: The bright highlight spot on the metal.

effects.name: Holographic
effects.description: Iridescent foil: rainbow sheen that shifts with angle and time.
effects.about: A shiny rainbow foil, like a holographic sticker, that shimmers as it moves.

params.label: Intensity
params.help: How strong the rainbow foil is.

params.label: Band scale
params.help: How wide the rainbow bands are. Bigger numbers mean more, thinner bands.

params.label: Shimmer
params.help: How fast the rainbow slides across. 0 keeps it still.

params.label: Angle
params.help: Which way the rainbow bands run.

params.label: Bevel
params.help: How much the rounded edges bend the rainbow, giving a raised, embossed look.

params.label: Pearlescence
params.help: Softens the rainbow into pearly pastel colors.

params.label: Keep colors
params.help: How much of the layer's original colors show through the foil.

effects.name: Gloss Sweep
effects.description: A specular highlight that glides across the surface and wraps its edges.
effects.about: A shiny streak of light that glides across the layer, like light catching a phone screen or a shiny button.

params.label: Position
params.help: Where the shine is across the layer. Animate it, or use Auto sweep instead.

params.label: Auto sweep
params.help: Makes the shine sweep across by itself, over and over. 0 turns this off so you can place it with Position.

params.label: Angle
params.help: The slant of the shine.

params.label: Width
params.help: How wide the streak of light is.

params.label: Softness
params.help: How soft the streak's edges are.

params.label: Intensity
params.help: How bright the shine is.

params.label: Color
params.help: The color of the shine.

params.label: Edge wrap
params.help: How much the shine wraps around the rounded edges.

effects.name: Glow
effects.description: Multi-pass bloom from bright areas, or an outer glow from the layer shape.
effects.about: Makes things shine with a soft halo of light around them.

params.label: Source
params.help: Bright areas makes only the brightest parts glow (like lights at night). Whole shape makes the entire layer glow around its outline.

params.label: Threshold
params.help: How bright something must be to glow. Lower it to make more of the image glow.

params.label: Radius
params.help: How far the glow spreads.

params.label: Intensity
params.help: How strong and bright the glow is.

params.label: Tint
params.help: Tints the glow. Turn the color's opacity up to use it; at 0% the glow keeps the original colors.

params.label: Saturation
params.help: How colorful the glow is. 0 is a white glow, higher is more vivid.

params.label: Only this hue
params.help: Selective glow. 100% lets every color glow. Lower it so only colors near the Glow hue shine (for example only cyan lines and letters), not the whole picture.

params.label: Glow hue
params.help: Which color glows when Only this hue is below 100%. 190° is cyan, 280° violet, 320° magenta, 40° gold.

effects.name: Drop Shadow
effects.description: Soft shadow cast behind the layer. Stack several for layered depth.
effects.about: Adds a soft shadow behind the layer so it floats above what is underneath.

params.label: Color
params.help: The shadow's color. Black is classic; a dark, colored shadow can look richer.

params.label: Opacity
params.help: How dark the shadow is.

params.label: Direction
params.help: Which way the shadow falls.

params.label: Distance
params.help: How far the shadow is from the layer. Further looks like it is floating higher.

params.label: Softness
params.help: How blurry the shadow is. Soft shadows look natural, sharp ones look graphic.

params.label: Light
params.help: Fixed in scene keeps the shadow falling the same way even if you rotate the layer. Turns with layer spins the shadow along with it.

effects.name: Light Rays
effects.description: Volumetric god rays streaming from bright areas away from a light point.
effects.about: Beams of light (god rays) shining out from the bright parts of the layer, away from a light point.

params.label: Light
params.help: Where the light comes from. Rays shoot away from this point. Drag the dot on the canvas.

params.label: Length
params.help: How long the rays are.

params.label: Exposure
params.help: How bright the rays are.

params.label: Decay
params.help: How quickly rays fade as they travel. Higher keeps them bright for longer.

params.label: Threshold
params.help: Only parts brighter than this cast rays. Raise it to get rays only from the brightest spots.

params.label: Color
params.help: The color of the light.

params.label: Flicker
params.help: Makes the rays shimmer and flicker like real light through dust.

effects.name: Neon Edge
effects.description: Glowing light hugging the edges of the shape: neon tubes, rim light.
effects.about: Turns the outline of the layer into a glowing neon tube.

params.label: Color
params.help: The neon color.

params.label: Tube width
params.help: How thick the bright tube is.

params.label: Glow spread
params.help: How far the soft glow spreads around the tube.

params.label: Intensity
params.help: How bright the neon is.

params.label: Position
params.help: Whether the tube sits on the edge (Center), just inside it, or just outside it.

params.label: Keep fill
params.help: How much of the original layer still shows inside the neon. 0 shows only the neon.

effects.name: Light Leak
effects.description: Drifting film light leaks screened over the image.
effects.about: Drifting warm blotches of light, like old film cameras that let light in.

params.label: Intensity
params.help: How strong the light leaks are.

params.label: Scale
params.help: How big the blotches of light are.

params.label: Drift
params.help: How fast the light drifts around.

params.label: Hue
params.help: The main color of the light. Around 20° is warm orange; 200° is cool blue.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Gaussian Blur
effects.description: Soft, even blur with independent horizontal and vertical amounts.
effects.about: Makes the layer soft and out of focus, evenly in every direction.

params.label: Radius
params.help: How blurry. 0 is sharp; bigger numbers are softer and dreamier.

params.label: Horizontal
params.help: How much of the blur goes sideways. Turn it down to blur only up-and-down.

params.label: Vertical
params.help: How much of the blur goes up-and-down. Turn it down to blur only sideways.

params.label: Edges
params.help: What happens at the layer's border. Fade out lets the edges go soft and see-through. Repeat keeps the edges solid, which is better for full-screen photos and video.

effects.name: Motion Blur
effects.description: Streaks along a direction, like fast movement.
effects.about: Smears the layer in one direction, like something moving very fast.

params.label: Length
params.help: How long the streaks are.

params.label: Angle
params.help: Which way the streaks point. 0° is sideways, 90° is up-and-down.

params.label: Centered
params.help: Both ways smears forward and backward evenly. Trailing only leaves a tail behind, like a speed trail.

effects.name: Spin Blur
effects.description: Rotational blur around a center point.
effects.about: Blurs in circles around a point, like a spinning wheel.

params.label: Angle
params.help: How far the spin smears. Small numbers are a gentle swirl; big numbers are a fast spin.

params.label: Center
params.help: The point everything spins around. Drag the dot on the canvas to move it.

effects.name: Zoom Blur
effects.description: Streaks rushing toward or away from a point.
effects.about: Streaks rush out from a point, like zooming the camera very fast.

params.label: Strength
params.help: How long the zoom streaks are.

params.label: Center
params.help: Where the zoom comes from. Drag the dot on the canvas to move it.

effects.name: Lens Blur
effects.description: Camera-style defocus with glowing bokeh highlights.
effects.about: A camera-style out-of-focus look where small lights turn into soft glowing circles.

params.label: Radius
params.help: How out of focus. Bigger means bigger, softer light circles.

params.label: Highlights
params.help: How much bright spots bloom into glowing circles. 0 is a plain blur.

params.label: Threshold
params.help: How bright a spot must be to become a glowing circle. Lower it to make more spots glow.

effects.name: Tilt-Shift
effects.description: Sharp band with blur falling off on either side, for miniature looks.
effects.about: Keeps a sharp stripe and blurs above and below it, so real scenes look like tiny toy models.

params.label: Blur
params.help: How blurry the out-of-focus areas get.

params.label: Focus
params.help: Where the sharp stripe sits. Drag the dot on the canvas.

params.label: Angle
params.help: Tilts the sharp stripe. 0° is a level, horizontal stripe.

params.label: Band
params.help: How tall the perfectly sharp stripe is.

params.label: Falloff
params.help: How gradually it goes from sharp to blurry. Low is a quick change, high is very gradual.

effects.name: Wave Warp
effects.description: Rolling waves that travel across the layer.
effects.about: Bends the layer into rolling waves, like a flag or water.

params.label: Height
params.help: How tall the waves are, so how far things get pushed.

params.label: Wavelength
params.help: Distance between wave tops. Small is a tight wiggle, big is long gentle waves.

params.label: Direction
params.help: Which way the waves travel.

params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the waves move. 0 freezes them; negative goes the other way.

params.label: Phase
params.help: Slides the waves along without moving them over time. Animate it for full control.

params.label: Shape
params.help: Sine is smooth and round, Triangle is zig-zag, Square is blocky steps.

effects.name: Twirl
effects.description: Spins pixels around a point, strongest at the center.
effects.about: Spins the middle of the layer like a whirlpool, with the edges staying put.

params.label: Angle
params.help: How much it twists. Positive spins one way, negative the other.

params.label: Radius
params.help: How big the twisting area is.

params.label: Center
params.help: The middle of the whirlpool. Drag the dot on the canvas.

effects.name: Bulge / Pinch
effects.description: Magnify outward like a lens, or pinch inward with negative strength.
effects.about: Puffs part of the layer outward like a magnifying glass, or pinches it inward.

params.label: Strength
params.help: Positive bulges outward (bigger), negative pinches inward (smaller).

params.label: Radius
params.help: How big the bulging area is.

params.label: Center
params.help: The middle of the bulge. Drag the dot on the canvas.

effects.name: Turbulent Displace
effects.description: Organic, noise-driven warping, with optional per-channel split.
effects.about: Wobbles the layer in a natural, wavy, wobbly way, like looking through moving water or melting.

params.label: Amount
params.help: How far pixels get pushed around.

params.label: Size
params.help: How big the wobbles are. Small is jittery, big is slow and wavy.

params.label: Detail
params.help: Adds smaller wobbles on top of the big ones. Higher is more complex.

params.label: Evolution
params.help: How fast the wobble changes over time. 0 freezes it.

params.label: RGB split
params.help: Pushes red, green and blue by different amounts for a colorful glitchy edge.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Heat Haze
effects.description: Shimmering air rising off hot ground.
effects.about: Shimmering, rising air, like heat above a hot road or a fire.

params.label: Intensity
params.help: How strongly the image shimmers.

params.label: Scale
params.help: How big the shimmer ripples are.

params.label: Rise speed
params.help: How fast the heat drifts upward.

params.label: Turbulence
params.help: How busy and chaotic the shimmer is.

params.label: Vertical stretch
params.help: Stretches ripples tall, like heat rising. 1 is round ripples.

params.label: Shimmer blur
params.help: Adds a little softness where the air shimmers most.

effects.name: Ripple
effects.description: Circular ripples spreading out from a point, like a drop in water.
effects.about: Rings spreading out from a point, like dropping a stone into water.

params.label: Height
params.help: How tall the ripples are, so how much the image bends.

params.label: Wavelength
params.help: Distance between rings.

params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the rings move outward. Negative moves them inward.

params.label: Reach
params.help: How far from the center the ripples reach before fading away.

params.label: Center
params.help: Where the stone hits the water. Drag the dot on the canvas.

effects.name: Lens Distortion
effects.description: Barrel or pincushion distortion with optional color fringing.
effects.about: Bends the image like a camera lens: bulging fisheye or pinched-in corners.

params.label: Amount
params.help: Positive bulges the middle out (fisheye). Negative pulls the corners out (pincushion).

params.label: Zoom
params.help: Zooms in to hide the bent edges, or out to see more.

params.label: Fringing
params.help: Adds rainbow color edges near the borders, like a cheap lens.

effects.name: Halftone
effects.description: Print-style screens: dots, lines, crosses or full CMYK.
effects.about: Turns the image into printed dots or lines, like comic books and newspapers.

params.label: Pattern
params.help: Dots, Lines or Cross pattern in one ink. CMYK uses four colored dot screens, like real magazine printing.

params.label: Cell size
params.help: How big each dot or line is.

params.label: Angle
params.help: Rotates the dot grid.

params.label: Softness
params.help: Soft dots blend more smoothly; hard dots look crisper and more graphic.

params.label: Contrast
params.help: Makes dots bigger in darks and smaller in lights more strongly.

params.label: Colors
params.help: Ink on paper uses the two colors below. Keep image colors uses the original colors for the dots.

params.label: Ink
params.help: The color of the dots.

params.label: Paper
params.help: The background color behind the dots.

effects.name: Film Grain
effects.description: Animated photographic grain that sits in the midtones.
effects.about: Adds the fine, flickering grain of real film for a cinematic, less digital look.

params.label: Amount
params.help: How visible the grain is.

params.label: Size
params.help: How big each grain speck is.

params.label: Color
params.help: How colorful the grain is. 0 is gray grain, higher adds colored specks.

params.label: Rate
params.help: How many times a second the grain changes. 24 feels like film; 0 freezes it.

params.label: Midtone bias
params.help: Puts more grain in the middle tones and less in pure black and white, like real film.

effects.name: Digital Glitch
effects.description: Slice displacement, channel offsets and blocky corruption.
effects.about: Digital glitches: slices jumping sideways, colors splitting apart and blocky corruption.

params.label: Amount
params.help: How often and how much it glitches. 0 is clean.

params.label: Slice shift
params.help: How far the glitched slices jump sideways.

params.label: RGB offset
params.help: How far red, green and blue split apart.

params.label: Slice height
params.help: How tall each glitched strip is.

params.label: Rate
params.help: How many times a second the glitch changes.

params.label: Block noise
params.help: Adds blocky, broken-video squares.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Pixelate
effects.description: Mosaic blocks: square, hexagon or LED dots.
effects.about: Turns the layer into big blocks, like a mosaic or an old video game.

params.label: Cell size
params.help: How big each block is.

params.label: Shape
params.help: Square blocks, Hexagon tiles, or round LED dots like a stadium screen.

params.label: Gap
params.help: Adds space between the blocks.

effects.name: Vignette
effects.description: Darkens (or tints) toward the edges of the frame.
effects.about: Darkens (or colors) the edges of the frame to draw the eye to the middle.

params.label: Amount
params.help: How dark the edges get.

params.label: Radius
params.help: How big the untouched middle area is.

params.label: Softness
params.help: How gradually the darkening fades in.

params.label: Roundness
params.help: How round the vignette is. Low follows the frame's rectangle; high is a circle.

params.label: Color
params.help: The color the edges fade to. Try white for a dreamy look.

effects.name: Posterize & Dither
effects.description: Reduce to a few tone levels, with ordered or noise dithering.
effects.about: Reduces the image to just a few shades, like a screen print or a retro game, with optional dither dots.

params.label: Levels
params.help: How many shades per color are kept. Fewer is bolder and more cartoon-like.

params.label: Dither
params.help: Mixes neighboring shades with tiny dots so the steps look smoother.

params.label: Dither type
params.help: Ordered makes a neat checkerboard-like pattern (retro computer look). Noise uses random specks.

params.label: Dither size
params.help: How big the dither dots are.

effects.name: Edges & Emboss
effects.description: Edge extraction (Sobel, Laplacian or morphological) drawn as glowing lines, composited over the image or on black, as ink lines, or a raised emboss.
effects.about: Finds the outlines in the image: glowing lines, lines drawn back over the picture, a pen drawing, or a raised stamped look. Great for keeping details readable after heavy color effects.

params.label: Style
params.help: Glowing edges makes bright lines on black. Edges over image draws them on top of the picture. Edges on black keeps only the lines. Dark lines over image inks the outlines like an illustration. Ink drawing makes dark lines on white, like a sketch. Emboss makes it look pressed into metal or paper.

params.label: Detector
params.help: How edges are found. Sobel is smooth and reliable. Laplacian catches fine detail and texture. Morphological gives thicker, bolder outlines.

params.label: Strength
params.help: How strong the lines are.

params.label: Edge width
params.help: How thick the lines are.

params.label: Edge threshold
params.help: Ignore faint edges below this, so only the important outlines stay.

params.label: Edge softness
params.help: How gently lines fade in at the threshold. 0 is a hard cut.

params.label: Edge brightness
params.help: How bright the lines are. Above 1 they can glow.

params.label: Edge color
params.help: The color of the lines.

params.label: Edge glow
params.help: A soft glow around the lines.

params.label: Glow radius
params.help: How far that glow spreads.

params.label: Emboss light
params.help: For Emboss: which direction the light comes from.

effects.name: CRT / VHS
effects.description: A physical analog video chain: tape, signal, sync and a real CRT tube — soft, unstable and glowing, from clean broadcast to destroyed tape.
effects.about: Sends the layer through a simulated analog video system: recorded to VHS tape, played back on an imperfect deck, sent down a cable and shown on a real tube TV. Start with a preset and the six big sliders; open Advanced controls for every part of the chain. Put it on an adjustment layer to run the whole picture through a TV.

params.label: Intensity
params.help: How much of the analog chain you see. 0 is your clean original; animate it from 0 to 100% for a clean-to-tape transition.

params.label: Analog fuzz
params.help: The single "make it feel analog" slider: softer detail sideways, softer color, softer beam, a little glow, tiny color fringes and noise. 20–40% makes crisp graphics feel like they are on a real monitor.

params.label: Tape age
params.help: How old and worn the tape is. Older means more noise, more color smear, weaker color, more dropouts and wobble.

params.label: Signal quality
params.help: How clean the cable/antenna signal is. 100% is a perfect connection. Lower adds rainbow patterns, crawling dots, ghosts, interference and, at the bottom, snow.

params.label: CRT glow
params.help: How much the tube glows: bloom around bright things, a wide soft halo, slightly fuzzy bright edges.

params.label: Instability
params.help: How unstable the playback and TV are: wobbling lines, drifting color, tracking trouble, tiny jitters. All of them move together, like one tired machine.

params.label: Process
params.help: Layer signal treats just this layer (respecting its transparency). Full frame treats the layer's whole box as a TV picture with a screen and bezel. For the whole video, put the effect on an adjustment layer.

params.label: Preview quality
params.help: Lower settings preview faster while you work. Auto lowers quality only while playing or dragging. Exports always use full quality.

params.label: Video standard
params.help: NTSC (480 lines, American/Japanese TV) or PAL (576 lines, European TV, a little steadier color). Custom lets you choose the number of lines.

params.label: Lines
params.help: How many scanlines fit in the height of the composition. Fewer lines look chunkier, like 240p game consoles.

params.label: Luma bandwidth
params.help: How much detail the brightness signal keeps, sideways. VHS is about 240, broadcast TV about 330, professional video 400 or more.

params.label: Chroma bandwidth
params.help: How much detail the color keeps. Analog color is much blurrier than brightness: VHS is around 30–40, which is why colors smear past edges.

params.label: Chroma delay
params.help: Slides the color slightly sideways relative to the picture, like a slightly misaligned color circuit.

params.label: Chroma phase
params.help: Turns all the colors around the color wheel, like the TV's "tint" knob.

params.label: Bleed distance
params.help: How far colors trail sideways beyond the edges of things.

params.label: Bleed direction
params.help: Which way colors trail. Real tape trails to the right.

params.label: Red bleed
params.help: How much reds smear. Saturated reds are famous for smearing on VHS.

params.label: Green bleed
params.help: How much greens smear.

params.label: Blue bleed
params.help: How much blues smear.

params.label: Edge sensitivity
params.help: Concentrates the smear at sharp color edges instead of everywhere.

params.label: Saturation influence
params.help: Lets strong, saturated colors smear further than pale ones.

params.label: Composite
params.help: How much the picture suffers from traveling as one combined "composite" signal: rainbow shimmer on fine patterns and crawling dots on colored edges. 0 is like separate component cables.

params.label: Comb filter
params.help: How good the TV is at separating color from brightness. High is a better TV with fewer rainbows and dots.

params.label: Dot crawl
params.help: Tiny dots that crawl along the edges of colored shapes.

params.label: Rainbow (cross-color)
params.help: False rainbow colors that appear on fine stripes and detailed patterns.

params.label: Subcarrier instability
params.help: Small line-by-line color errors, so colors subtly shimmer (NTSC: hue; PAL: saturation).

params.label: Colorburst instability
params.help: Occasional moments where the color loses its reference and briefly shifts or fades.

params.label: Edge ringing
params.help: Thin light and dark outlines next to hard edges, from the VCR's sharpening circuit.

params.label: Ringing radius
params.help: How far those outlines sit from the edge.

params.label: VHS tape
params.help: Turns the VHS tape part on or off. Off is like a live signal straight to the TV.

params.label: Generation
params.help: How many times the tape has been copied. 1 is a first recording, 2 a copy, 3 a copy of a copy. Each copy is softer, noisier and smearier.

params.label: Recording speed
params.help: SP is the best quality. LP and EP squeeze more onto the tape and look noisier and softer.

params.label: Tape wear
params.help: Physical wear on the tape: more dropouts and noise.

params.label: Tape noise
params.help: How much hiss and grain the tape adds.

params.label: Chroma lag
params.help: Color trails a moment behind moving things, especially bright reds.

params.label: Lag falloff
params.help: How long the color trail lingers.

params.label: Motion sensitivity
params.help: Limits color trails to moving areas so still parts stay clean.

params.label: Saturation response
params.help: Lets saturated colors trail more than pale ones.

params.label: Sync & tracking
params.help: Turns timing problems on or off: wobble, tracking bands, head switching, rolling and interlacing.

params.label: Time-base error
params.help: How far lines wander sideways because the tape's timing is not perfect. A little makes straight edges feel alive; a lot makes waves.

params.label: Wander speed
params.help: How fast the wandering changes.

params.label: Wave height
params.help: How many lines move together in one wave. Small is a fast ripple, large is a slow bend.

params.label: Breathing
params.help: A slow, whole-picture sway on top of the wandering.

params.label: Line jitter
params.help: A tiny line-by-line shiver.

params.label: Turbulence
params.help: Patches where the wandering suddenly gets rougher.

params.label: Smoothness
params.help: How smooth the shiver is from line to line. Low is rough and scratchy.

params.label: Line shifts
params.help: Now and then a group of lines jumps sideways for a moment.

params.label: Line grouping
params.help: How many lines jump together.

params.label: Tearing
params.help: Rare moments where the picture tears sideways below a line, then settles.

params.label: Tracking error
params.help: Noisy, torn horizontal bands from bad tape tracking.

params.label: Tracking behavior
params.help: Auto drifts and comes and goes with the instability. Static stays in one place, Rolling moves up the picture, Intermittent pops in and out.

params.label: Bands
params.help: How many tracking bands there can be.

params.label: Band size
params.help: How tall each band is.

params.label: Band position
params.help: Where the band sits (for Static and Rolling).

params.label: Band drift speed
params.help: How fast bands move. Negative moves them the other way.

params.label: Band warp
params.help: How far lines inside a band get pulled sideways.

params.label: Band noise
params.help: How much static fills the band.

params.label: Band chroma loss
params.help: How much color drops out inside the band.

params.label: Band persistence
params.help: How long bands stay when they appear.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

params.label: Head switching
params.help: The ragged, skewed strip at the very bottom of VHS playback where the tape heads switch over.

params.label: Head-switch size
params.help: How many lines at the bottom are affected.

params.label: Head-switch shear
params.help: How far those bottom lines bend sideways.

params.label: Head-switch noise
params.help: Static in the bottom strip.

params.label: Head-switch color error
params.help: Wrong colors in the bottom strip.

params.label: Head-switch flicker
params.help: How much the bottom strip flickers.

params.label: Head-switch offset
params.help: Moves the strip up from the bottom edge.

params.label: Vertical roll
params.help: Occasionally the TV loses its grip and the picture rolls vertically for a moment, showing the black bar between frames.

params.label: Vertical hold
params.help: A small, constant vertical bounce, like a loose vertical hold knob.

params.label: Interlacing
params.help: Old video draws odd and even lines a moment apart. Moving things get comb-like edges; still things stay clean.

params.label: Field order
params.help: Which set of lines is drawn first. Swap it if moving edges look wrong.

params.label: Deinterlacing
params.help: How the two sets of lines are combined: Weave shows combs, Blend shows soft double images, Bob rebuilds lines and looks jaggy.

params.label: Field motion sensitivity
params.help: Keeps interlacing to moving areas only.

params.label: Field offset
params.help: How far apart in time the two sets of lines are.

params.label: Field flicker
params.help: Thin horizontal details twitter slightly, like on a real interlaced TV.

params.label: CRT display
params.help: Turns the tube on or off. Off shows the video signal as if captured digitally, without scanlines or phosphors.

params.label: Scanlines
params.help: How visible the scanlines are. Each line is a glowing electron beam with dark gaps between.

params.label: Beam width
params.help: How thick each beam is. Thick beams fill the gaps; thin beams leave dark lines.

params.label: Thinnest beam
params.help: Beam thickness in dark parts of the picture.

params.label: Widest beam
params.help: Beam thickness in bright parts. Bright lines swell, like on a real tube.

params.label: Beam shape
params.help: The beam's profile. 2 is a soft round beam; higher is flatter with crisper edges.

params.label: Brightness response
params.help: How strongly brightness changes the beam thickness.

params.label: Scanline bloom
params.help: Very bright lines spill onto their neighbors.

params.label: Scanline bloom threshold
params.help: How bright a line must be before it spills.

params.label: Focus softness
params.help: Overall softness of the beam's focus. Analog fuzz, not a blur filter: bright parts soften more than dark.

params.label: Bright blur
params.help: How much brighter areas lose focus compared with dark ones.

params.label: Black detail
params.help: Keeps dark areas crisp while bright ones soften.

params.label: Misconvergence
params.help: How far the red, green and blue beams miss each other, giving thin colored fringes. Keep it small.

params.label: Edge misconvergence
params.help: Makes the fringes grow toward the edges and corners, like a real tube.

params.label: Red offset
params.help: Fine-tune where the red beam lands (sideways, up/down).

params.label: Green offset
params.help: Fine-tune where the green beam lands.

params.label: Blue offset
params.help: Fine-tune where the blue beam lands.

params.label: Phosphor mask
params.help: The pattern of tiny red, green and blue phosphors on the glass: stripes (aperture grille, PVM, Trinitron), little bricks (slot mask, consumer TV) or dots (shadow mask). Zoom in to see it.

params.label: Mask strength
params.help: How visible the phosphor pattern is.

params.label: Triad size
params.help: The size of one red-green-blue group. Very small patterns fade out automatically to avoid moiré when zoomed out.

params.label: Mask softness
params.help: How soft the edges of each phosphor are.

params.label: Subpixel intensity
params.help: How dark the gaps between the red, green and blue phosphors are.

params.label: Vertical spacing
params.help: Spacing of the slots or dots up and down.

params.label: RGB arrangement
params.help: The order of the colored phosphors.

params.label: Mask rotation
params.help: Turns the phosphor pattern sideways, like a TV mounted on its side.

params.label: Brightness compensation
params.help: Brightens the picture to make up for the darkening from the phosphor pattern.

params.label: Persistence
params.help: Bright phosphors keep glowing for an instant, so fast bright things leave a faint trail.

params.label: Decay time
params.help: How long the afterglow lasts.

params.label: Brightness dependency
params.help: Brighter things glow longer.

params.label: Color persistence
params.help: Lets the colors fade at different speeds (green lingers, blue fades fast).

params.label: Glow
params.help: Turns all the glow on or off.

params.label: Phosphor bloom
params.help: Bright parts of the tube spread light into their surroundings.

params.label: Bloom threshold
params.help: How bright something must be to bloom.

params.label: Bloom radius
params.help: How far the bloom spreads.

params.label: Bloom softness
params.help: How gradually things start to bloom.

params.label: Halation
params.help: A wider, dimmer halo around bright things, from light scattering inside the glass.

params.label: Halation radius
params.help: How wide the halo is.

params.label: Halation threshold
params.help: How bright something must be to get a halo.

params.label: Halation color
params.help: The halo's color. Real tubes glow slightly warm.

params.label: Halation falloff
params.help: How far the halo fades out: low is tight, high is long and soft.

params.label: Glass diffusion
params.help: The thick front glass scatters a little light over the whole picture. Keep it very low.

params.label: Diffusion radius
params.help: How far that scattered light spreads.

params.label: Diffusion edge response
params.help: Makes the scattering stronger toward the edges of the glass.

params.label: Overbright glow
params.help: The very brightest parts glow white-hot instead of clipping flat.

params.label: Noise
params.help: Turns all noise and interference on or off.

params.label: Luma noise
params.help: Fine brightness grain, streaky along the lines.

params.label: Chroma noise
params.help: Larger, soft blobs of colored noise.

params.label: Line noise
params.help: Whole lines flickering slightly, and the odd short bright streak.

params.label: Tape grain
params.help: A faint texture from the tape itself.

params.label: RF interference
params.help: Diagonal interference patterns from a poor antenna or cable.

params.label: Snow
params.help: The classic black-and-white static of a weak signal.

params.label: Hum bars
params.help: Soft bright and dark bands slowly rolling up the picture, from electrical hum.

params.label: Noise size
params.help: Makes all the noise bigger or smaller.

params.label: Noise rate
params.help: How many times per second the noise changes.

params.label: Noise persistence
params.help: How smoothly the noise changes from frame to frame. Higher looks less like crawling static.

params.label: Noise contrast
params.help: Makes all the noise stronger or weaker.

params.label: Noisier in darks
params.help: Puts more noise in dark areas, like real video.

params.label: Ghosting
params.help: Faint copies of the picture offset sideways, from signal reflections in cables and antennas.

params.label: Ghost offset
params.help: How far the ghost sits. Negative puts it on the other side.

params.label: Echoes
params.help: How many ghost copies there are.

params.label: Echo decay
params.help: How quickly each extra ghost fades.

params.label: Ghost signal
params.help: Whether the ghost shows brightness, color or both.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

params.label: Color style
params.help: A starting color character: neutral, warm family TV, cool professional monitor, faded old TV, cheap tape, punchy camcorder or accurate broadcast monitor.

params.label: Black level
params.help: Lifts black slightly so it is never perfectly black, like real video.

params.label: White level
params.help: How bright white is.

params.label: Gamma
params.help: Brightens or darkens the middle tones.

params.label: Saturation
params.help: How colorful the picture is.

params.label: Chroma strength
params.help: Strength of the color signal before it is decoded. Turn it up for bold, bleeding color.

params.label: Hue drift
params.help: Colors slowly drift around the color wheel along with the instability.

params.label: White balance
params.help: Cool (blue) to warm (orange) whites.

params.label: Color cast
params.help: An overall color cast. Its opacity sets how strong.

params.label: Highlight warmth
params.help: Warms (or cools, below 0) just the brightest parts.

params.label: Shadow tint
params.help: Adds color to the shadows. Its opacity sets how strong.

params.label: Channel gain
params.help: Separate brightness for red, green and blue.

params.label: Black glow
params.help: Black glows faintly, like a tube that is never fully dark.

params.label: Shadow contamination
params.help: Dirty, slightly colored shadows.

params.label: Soft clipping
params.help: Bright parts roll off gently toward white instead of clipping hard.

params.label: White compression
params.help: Squeezes the very top of the brightness range.

params.label: Chroma loss near white
params.help: Colors fade toward white in the brightest areas, like a real signal near its limit.

params.label: Screen shape
params.help: The shape of the glass: flat, slightly curved, strongly curved, cylindrical like a Trinitron, or Custom.

params.label: Horizontal curvature
params.help: Custom side-to-side curvature.

params.label: Vertical curvature
params.help: Custom top-to-bottom curvature.

params.label: Overscan
params.help: Zooms the picture slightly past the edges of the tube, like real TVs did. Negative shows the borders.

params.label: Corner radius
params.help: How rounded the tube's corners are (Full frame).

params.label: Edge stretch
params.help: Stretches (or squeezes) the picture toward the sides.

params.label: Edge blur
params.help: Softer focus toward the edges and corners.

params.label: Corner darkening
params.help: Darkens the corners where the beam lands at an angle.

params.label: Edge distortion
params.help: A slight wavy distortion along the sides.

params.label: Deflection wobble
params.help: Bends the whole picture with broad, magnetic-looking waves, like the deflection coils are being disturbed.

params.label: Wobble size
params.help: How big those bends are.

params.label: Wobble speed
params.help: How fast the bends move.

params.label: Glass
params.help: Turns the glass surface on or off.

params.label: Surface reflection
params.help: A soft reflection of the room on the glass.

params.label: Edge reflection
params.help: The glass catches more light at its edges.

params.label: Ambient light
params.help: Room light falling on the glass, which lifts the blacks.

params.label: Glass tint
params.help: The faint color of the glass. Its opacity sets how strong.

params.label: Reflection roughness
params.help: How blurry the reflection is.

params.label: Bezel shadow
params.help: A shadow just inside the frame where the plastic bezel meets the glass.

params.label: Bezel color
params.help: The color of the TV's frame around the tube (Full frame).

params.label: Damage
params.help: Turns tape damage on or off.

params.label: Dropouts
params.help: Short horizontal streaks where flakes of the tape lost signal. They last a frame or two.

params.label: Dropout height
params.help: How many lines tall a dropout is.

params.label: Dropout length
params.help: How long the streaks are.

params.label: Signal loss
params.help: How much of the picture is lost inside a streak.

params.label: Dropout chroma loss
params.help: How much color is lost inside a streak.

params.label: Dropout duration
params.help: How many frames each dropout lasts.

params.label: Clustering
params.help: Makes dropouts bunch together in the same area, like one damaged patch of tape.

params.label: Vertical distribution
params.help: How spread out dropouts are from top to bottom.

params.label: Severity
params.help: The chance of occasional bigger, longer damage.

params.label: Dropout compensation
params.help: Like a real VCR, fills each dropout with the line above so it is less obvious. Off shows bright or dark streaks.

params.label: Tape crease
params.help: Rare moments where a creased part of the tape passes: wavy, torn, stretched bands and collapsing color.

params.label: Crease severity
params.help: How bad a crease looks.

params.label: Crease duration
params.help: How long a crease lasts.

params.label: Crease width
params.help: How tall the damaged band is.

params.label: Recovery speed
params.help: How quickly the picture recovers afterwards.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

params.label: Video feedback
params.help: Feeds the previous frame back into the picture, like pointing a camera at its own monitor: echoes, tunnels and trails.

params.label: Feedback amount
params.help: How strong the feedback is.

params.label: Feedback decay
params.help: How long the echoes last.

params.label: Feedback scale
params.help: Each echo is a little bigger (above 1) or smaller, making tunnels.

params.label: Feedback rotation
params.help: Each echo turns a little, making spirals.

params.label: Feedback offset
params.help: Each echo shifts sideways or up/down.

params.label: Feedback blur
params.help: Each echo gets a little softer.

params.label: Feedback hue shift
params.help: Each echo shifts color, making rainbows.

params.label: Feedback saturation
params.help: How colorful the echoes are.

params.label: Feedback luma threshold
params.help: Only bright parts feed back above this level.

params.label: Feedback blend
params.help: How echoes combine with the picture: Add and Screen glow, Lighten keeps the brightest, Mix blends.

params.label: Exposure
params.help: Brightens or darkens everything, in camera stops.

params.label: Brightness flicker
params.help: The whole picture pulses slightly in brightness.

params.label: Micro-jitter X
params.help: A tiny sideways shake you feel more than see.

params.label: Micro-jitter Y
params.help: A tiny up-and-down shake.

params.label: Jitter rate
params.help: How fast the tiny shake changes.

params.label: Jitter smoothness
params.help: Smooth drifting (high) or quick little jumps (low).

params.label: Drift speed
params.help: How fast the shared analog drift moves. Every unstable part follows it together.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

presets.name: Home VHS · good CRT
presets.description: Ordinary consumer VHS played on a decent late-80s/90s TV. Subtle.

presets.name: Just a hint
presets.description: Barely there: makes clean vector graphics feel like they are on a real monitor.

presets.name: Broadcast Monitor
presets.description: A studio monitor fed a clean signal: crisp, neutral, stable.

presets.name: Consumer CRT
presets.description: A family TV on a composite cable: warm, a little soft, glowing.

presets.name: PVM
presets.description: A professional video monitor: sharp scanlines, fine grille, cool whites.

presets.name: Aperture Grille
presets.description: Vertical phosphor stripes on a flat-ish cylindrical tube.

presets.name: Shadow Mask
presets.description: Round phosphor dots in triads on a curved tube.

presets.name: Small Bedroom TV
presets.description: A little portable on an RF lead: coarse mask, round corners, fuzzy and warm.

presets.name: Fresh SP Tape
presets.description: A brand-new tape at the best speed: soft color, very little else.

presets.name: Normal Home VHS
presets.description: A tape that has been watched a few times.

presets.name: Home Movie
presets.description: Camcorder footage: punchy color, wobbly timing, smeary chroma.

presets.name: Rental Tape
presets.description: Worn from a hundred plays: tracking hiccups, dropouts, tired color.

presets.name: Dubbed Tape
presets.description: A copy of a tape: softer, ringing edges, smeared color.

presets.name: Third-Generation Copy
presets.description: A copy of a copy of a copy.

presets.name: Worn Tape
presets.description: Stretched and scratched: frequent dropouts, the odd crease.

presets.name: Bad Tracking
presets.description: The tracking knob needs adjusting: noisy bands crawl through the picture.

presets.name: Damaged Tape
presets.description: Creased and chewed: tears, collapses, heavy dropouts.

presets.name: Nearly Unwatchable
presets.description: Everything that can go wrong with a tape, at once.

presets.name: Clean Component
presets.description: Separate color channels: the cleanest analog path.

presets.name: S-Video
presets.description: Luma and chroma on separate wires: no rainbow, softer color.

presets.name: Clean Composite
presets.description: One wire, a good TV: faint dot crawl on colored edges.

presets.name: Consumer Composite
presets.description: A cheap decoder: rainbows on fine detail, crawling dots on color edges.

presets.name: Cheap RF TV
presets.description: Through the antenna socket: ghosts, interference, weak color.

presets.name: Damaged RF
presets.description: A failing antenna: snow, hum bars, rolling color.

presets.name: Poor Reception
presets.description: Barely a signal: the picture fights through the snow.

presets.name: Unstable Sync
presets.description: The TV keeps losing lock: wandering lines, tears and rolls.

presets.name: Video Synth
presets.description: Saturated, glowing color with smooth analog warping, like a video synthesizer.

presets.name: Wobbulator
presets.description: The deflection coils are being driven by sound: broad magnetic bends.

presets.name: Circuit Bent
presets.description: Rewired electronics: folding sync, torn lines, colors swapping places.

presets.name: Analog Feedback
presets.description: A camera pointed at its own monitor: echoing, spiralling trails.

presets.name: Broadcast Dream
presets.description: A clean signal on a beautiful tube: soft phosphor glow, barely moving.

presets.name: Neon CRT
presets.description: Hot beams and saturated phosphors over deep scanline gaps.

presets.name: Damaged Installation
presets.description: An old gallery TV on a worn playback deck that keeps losing sync.

presets.name: Videotape Memory
presets.description: Soft, fuzzy, slightly faded tape with long color bleed and a gentle glow — no glitches.

presets.name: 1990s Title Card
presets.description: A fresh tape of a bold title: rich chroma, light noise, glowing CRT.

presets.name: Late-Night Cable
presets.description: A cheap cable channel recorded at 3 a.m.: noisy blacks, weak color, ghosts.

effects.name: Dither Pro
effects.description: Reduce the image to a palette with a threshold pattern: Bayer, blue noise, error diffusion, stochastic grain, halftone, lines. 1-bit to Game Boy to PICO-8. The pattern stays put on the image, so it reads as print texture rather than video noise.
effects.about: Reduces the picture to a few colors and fakes the in-between shades with a pattern of dots or lines, like old computers, Game Boys and print.

params.label: Pattern
params.help: The dot pattern used to fake in-between shades. Bayer is the classic retro checker. Blue noise is fine and even, like good print. Error diffusion looks like a scanned newspaper. Stochastic grain clumps like film or photocopy toner. Halftone/Lines/Waves make print-style patterns.

params.label: Palette
params.help: Which colors are allowed. Two colors (1-bit) uses Dark and Light. Ramp shades between them. Color levels keeps color. Game Boy, CGA, PICO-8 and Sepia are classic palettes. Four colors uses all four color slots. Poster: cyan & violet is a screen-print palette.

params.label: Dither scale
params.help: How big each dot is. Bigger is chunkier and more visible.

params.label: Pattern size
params.help: How big the halftone, line, wave and grain patterns are.

params.label: Color quantization
params.help: How many shades each color can have (for Ramp and Color levels). 2 is the most extreme.

params.label: Dither amount
params.help: How strongly the pattern mixes neighboring shades. 0 gives flat poster bands.

params.label: Threshold
params.help: Where the cut between dark and light sits. Lower makes more of the picture light, higher makes more of it dark.

params.label: Contrast
params.help: Punchier or flatter before dithering.

params.label: Brightness
params.help: Lighter or darker before dithering.

params.label: Gamma
params.help: Shifts the middle tones lighter or darker before dithering.

params.label: Pattern angle
params.help: Rotates line, halftone and wave patterns.

params.label: Shimmer
params.help: Makes the pattern shimmer by changing it this many times per second. 0 keeps it still.

params.label: Temporal stability
params.help: With Shimmer on: how much of the pattern stays put each step. 100% barely changes (print texture that breathes); 0% changes completely (video noise).

params.label: Dark
params.help: The dark color (and first palette color).

params.label: Light
params.help: The light color (and second palette color).

params.label: Color 3
params.help: Third color, used by the Four colors palette.

params.label: Color 4
params.help: Fourth color, used by the Four colors palette.

params.label: Luma weight
params.help: How much the pattern follows brightness.

params.label: Chroma weight
params.help: How much the pattern also wobbles the colors separately, for richer colored dots (Color levels and palettes).

params.label: Dark is clear
params.help: Makes the darkest color see-through, so only the light dots remain on top of whatever is below.

params.label: Noise seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Scan Modulation
effects.description: Redraws the image as horizontal scan lines that thicken in bright areas and wave and jitter with noise, like an oscilloscope or a modulated signal.
effects.about: Redraws the picture as horizontal scan lines that thicken where it is bright and wave and squiggle with noise, like a signal on an oscilloscope.

params.label: Line spacing
params.help: Distance between lines.

params.label: Max thickness
params.help: How thick lines get in the brightest parts. Near 100% they merge into solid areas.

params.label: Min thickness
params.help: How thick lines stay in the darkest parts. 0 makes dark areas empty.

params.label: Brightness lift
params.help: Bright parts push the line up (or down if negative), so shapes look raised like a 3D landscape.

params.label: Wave
params.help: Slow wavy bending of the lines.

params.label: Wave size
params.help: How long those slow waves are.

params.label: Modulation
params.help: Fast squiggly modulation along each line.

params.label: Modulation size
params.help: How tight those squiggles are.

params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the waves and squiggles move.

params.label: Contrast
params.help: How strongly brightness changes the lines.

params.label: Angle
params.help: Tilts the lines.

params.label: Line color
params.help: Color of the lines.

params.label: Background
params.help: Color between the lines.

params.label: Image colors
params.help: Colors each line with the picture's own colors instead of the line color.

effects.name: ASCII Art
effects.description: Rebuilds the image from text characters, from classic ASCII to blocks, binary or falling Matrix code.
effects.about: Rebuilds the picture out of text characters, like ASCII art, block graphics or falling Matrix code.

params.label: Character size
params.help: How big each character is.

params.label: Characters
params.help: Which characters to draw with. Classic and Detailed use letters and symbols, Blocks uses shaded squares, Binary uses 0 and 1, Matrix uses Japanese katakana.

params.label: Color
params.help: Image colors each character from the picture. Single uses the text color. Matrix makes glowing green code.

params.label: Text color
params.help: The character color (for Single).

params.label: Background
params.help: The background behind the characters. Set its opacity to 0 for none.

params.label: Contrast
params.help: How strongly bright and dark areas pick different characters.

params.label: Brightness
params.help: Shifts everything toward denser or lighter characters.

params.label: Invert
params.help: Swaps light and dark: dense characters where it was bright.

params.label: Rain speed
params.help: Makes Matrix-style streams of characters fall down the screen. 0 turns it off.

params.label: Glow
params.help: Makes the characters glow softly.

effects.name: Dither Reveal
effects.description: Reveals or hides the layer through a dithered gradient, pixel by pixel. Animate Progress for game-title style reveals.
effects.about: Makes the layer appear (or disappear) through a dithered, pixel-by-pixel gradient, like the title reveals in retro and dark-fantasy games. Keyframe Progress from 0% to 100%.

params.label: Progress
params.help: How much of the layer is revealed. 0% is hidden, 100% fully shown. Animate this.

params.label: Direction
params.help: Which way the reveal travels across the layer.

params.label: Gradient width
params.help: How wide the dithered transition zone is. Wide is a long soft fade, narrow is a sharp wipe.

params.label: Pixel size
params.help: How big the dither pixels are.

params.label: Pattern
params.help: Bayer is an orderly retro checker, Noise is random, Dots grows round dots.

params.label: Edge glow
params.help: A glowing line where pixels are switching on.

params.label: Edge color
params.help: The color of that glow.

effects.name: Sketch & Hatching
effects.description: Pen or pencil drawing: layered hatching that gets denser in the shadows, outlines, wobble and paper.
effects.about: Turns the picture into a pen or pencil drawing: lines that crisscross more in the shadows, plus outlines, on paper.

params.label: Line spacing
params.help: Distance between hatching lines.

params.label: Line width
params.help: How thick each pen line is.

params.label: Angle
params.help: The direction of the first set of lines.

params.label: Hatch layers
params.help: How many crisscrossing sets of lines build up in the darkest parts.

params.label: Contrast
params.help: How strongly dark areas get more lines.

params.label: Hand wobble
params.help: Makes lines a little wavy, like a real hand.

params.label: Scribble
params.help: Turns straight hatching into loose, loopy scribbles.

params.label: Outlines
params.help: Draws outlines around shapes and edges.

params.label: Line boil
params.help: Redraws the wobble this many times per second, so lines shimmer like hand-drawn animation. 0 keeps them still.

params.label: Ink
params.help: The pen color.

params.label: Paper
params.help: The paper color.

params.label: Colored pencil
params.help: Colors the lines with the picture's own colors, like colored pencils.

params.label: Paper lines
params.help: Adds notebook lines (with a red margin) or graph paper.

effects.name: Low Poly
effects.description: Breaks the image into flat triangles (faceted gem / low-poly art), a wireframe mesh, or both.
effects.about: Breaks the picture into flat triangles like low-poly 3D art or a cut gem, or shows just the triangle mesh as a wireframe.

params.label: Triangle size
params.help: How big each triangle is.

params.label: Irregularity
params.help: How uneven the triangles are. 0 is a perfect grid.

params.label: Style
params.help: Facets fills each triangle with one color. Wireframe draws only the edges. Both shows both.

params.label: Edge width
params.help: How thick the triangle edges are.

params.label: Edge color
params.help: The color of the edges.

params.label: Facet shading
params.help: Gives each triangle a slightly different brightness so it looks faceted.

params.label: Facet color
params.help: Image takes colors from the picture. Rainbow gives each triangle a bright color. Edge color only leaves just the lines.

params.label: Saturation
params.help: How colorful the triangles are.

params.label: Drift
params.help: Makes the triangle corners slowly float around. 0 keeps them still.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Chromatic Split
effects.description: Separates red, green and blue (or a full rainbow) along a direction or out from a center, like a cheap lens or an anaglyph.
effects.about: Pulls the red, green and blue parts of the picture apart, like a cheap lens, 3D glasses or a glitch.

params.label: Amount
params.help: How far the colors separate.

params.label: Direction
params.help: Straight splits along one direction. From center splits outward, more toward the edges, like a lens.

params.label: Angle
params.help: The direction of the split (Straight mode).

params.label: Center
params.help: The middle point for From center mode. Drag the dot on the canvas.

params.label: Edge falloff
params.help: How much stronger the split gets toward the edges (From center mode).

params.label: Rainbow
params.help: Smears a full rainbow instead of three separate colors.

effects.name: Light & Shade
effects.description: Lights the layer like a 3D object: soft or toon (cel) shading, highlights, shadows, rim light and specular, from the shape or from the image brightness.
effects.about: Lights the layer as if it were a 3D object: rounded highlights and shadows, cartoon (toon) shading, shine and rim light.

params.label: Surface from
params.help: Shape edges makes the layer look puffy and rounded from its outline. Brightness also uses light and dark parts of the picture as bumps.

params.label: Roundness
params.help: How far in from the edge the rounding goes.

params.label: Bumpiness
params.help: How much the picture's brightness raises the surface (Brightness mode).

params.label: Light angle
params.help: Which direction the light comes from.

params.label: Light height
params.help: How high the light is. Low light makes long, dramatic shading.

params.label: Toon steps
params.help: Cartoon shading: 0 is smooth, 1 to 6 makes flat bands of light and shadow.

params.label: Highlight
params.help: Color added on the lit side. Its opacity sets how strong.

params.label: Shadow
params.help: Color added on the dark side. Its opacity sets how strong.

params.label: Specular
params.help: The bright shiny spot where the light reflects.

params.label: Shininess
params.help: How small and sharp that shiny spot is.

params.label: Rim light
params.help: A glowing edge light around the outline, like light from behind.

params.label: Rim color
params.help: The color of the rim light.

effects.name: Palette Map
effects.description: Repaints brightness with up to six colors, as smooth gradients or hard poster/toon bands. Can cycle for animated color.
effects.about: Repaints the picture using up to six colors from dark to light, either as smooth gradients or as flat poster or cartoon bands.

params.label: Colors
params.help: How many of the colors below are used.

params.label: Hard bands
params.help: Hard bands gives flat poster areas. Lower it to blend smoothly between colors.

params.label: Color 1 (darks)
params.help: Color for the darkest parts.

params.label: Color 2
params.help: The next color up from the darks.

params.label: Color 3
params.help: The middle color.

params.label: Color 4
params.help: Color for the lighter parts.

params.label: Color 5
params.help: Fifth color (when Colors is 5 or more).

params.label: Color 6 (lights)
params.help: Color for the very brightest parts (when Colors is 6).

params.label: Contrast
params.help: Spreads the picture across more of the colors (higher) or fewer (lower).

params.label: Shift
params.help: Slides which color goes where.

params.label: Cycle speed
params.help: Makes the colors flow through the picture over time. 0 keeps them still.

effects.name: Fire
effects.description: Animated flames licking up from the layer's edges, with embers and charring.
effects.about: Sets the layer on fire: animated flames rise from its top edges, with floating embers and scorched color.

params.label: Flame height
params.help: How tall the flames reach.

params.label: Intensity
params.help: How bright and thick the fire is.

params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast the flames flicker upward.

params.label: Flame size
params.help: How big the flame tongues are.

params.label: Turbulence
params.help: How ragged and turbulent the flames are.

params.label: Wrap sides
params.help: How much the flames also climb up the sides, not just the top.

params.label: Core color
params.help: The hottest color, at the base of the flames.

params.label: Flame color
params.help: The main flame color.

params.label: Smoke color
params.help: The color at the flame tips, where it turns to smoke.

params.label: Char layer
params.help: Darkens the layer itself, like it is being scorched.

params.label: Embers
params.help: Sparks floating up from the fire.

effects.name: Hollow
effects.description: Cuts out the inside of any layer, leaving a band of the chosen thickness along its edge. Works on shapes, text and images.
effects.about: Hollows out the layer so only a band along its edge remains, like a ring or outlined letters. Works on any shape, text or image.

params.label: Thickness
params.help: How thick the remaining band is.

params.label: Band sits
params.help: Inside keeps the band within the original shape. Centered straddles the edge. Outside puts it around the shape.

params.label: Softness
params.help: How soft the band's edges are.

params.label: Keep inside
params.help: How much of the original inside to keep. 0 is fully hollow.

effects.name: Grid & Lines
effects.description: Graph paper, blueprint grids, dot grids, stripes, hexagons and isometric lines. Scrolls if you want.
effects.about: Draws a grid or pattern: graph paper, blueprint lines, dots, stripes, isometric or hexagons. Can scroll for animated backgrounds.

params.label: Style
params.help: The kind of pattern. Blueprint adds thicker lines every few squares.

params.label: Spacing
params.help: Distance between lines.

params.label: Line width
params.help: How thick the lines are.

params.label: Major every
params.help: For Blueprint: how many small squares between thick lines.

params.label: Line color
params.help: Line color. Its opacity sets how strong the lines are.

params.label: Background
params.help: Background color. Set opacity to 0 to draw only lines.

params.label: Angle
params.help: Rotates the pattern.

params.label: Scroll
params.help: Moves the pattern. Animate it to slide the grid.

params.label: Scroll speed
params.help: Scrolls the pattern sideways by itself.

params.label: Blend
params.help: How the pattern is combined with your layer. Replace shows only the pattern (inside the layer's shape). Over layer puts it on top. Multiply darkens, Screen lightens, Overlay adds contrast.

effects.name: Starfield
effects.description: Twinkling stars in parallax layers over an optional nebula. Drift, or fly through them.
effects.about: A night sky of twinkling stars with optional colorful nebula clouds. Drift past them or fly through them.

params.label: Density
params.help: How many stars.

params.label: Star size
params.help: How big the stars are.

params.label: Twinkle
params.help: How much the stars sparkle.

params.label: Drift
params.help: Drifts the stars sideways. Far stars move slower, giving depth.

params.label: Fly-through
params.help: Flies through the stars toward you (positive) or away (negative). 0 turns it off.

params.label: Star color
params.help: The color of the stars.

params.label: Nebula
params.help: How bright the cloudy nebula is. 0 hides it.

params.label: Nebula color 1
params.help: First nebula color.

params.label: Nebula color 2
params.help: Second nebula color.

params.label: Space color
params.help: The color of empty space.

params.label: Nebula size
params.help: How big the nebula clouds are.

params.label: Blend
params.help: How the pattern is combined with your layer. Replace shows only the pattern (inside the layer's shape). Over layer puts it on top. Multiply darkens, Screen lightens, Overlay adds contrast.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Color Adjust
effects.description: Exposure, contrast, tones, white balance, saturation, vibrance and hue.
effects.about: All the basic photo adjustments in one place: brightness, contrast, warmth, color strength and more.

params.label: Exposure
params.help: Overall brightness, like opening or closing a camera's lens. +1 is twice as bright, −1 is half.

params.label: Contrast
params.help: Difference between darks and lights. Up for punchy, down for flat and faded.

params.label: Highlights
params.help: Brightens or darkens only the bright parts. Turn down to bring back detail in a bright sky.

params.label: Shadows
params.help: Brightens or darkens only the dark parts. Turn up to see into the shadows.

params.label: Whites
params.help: Sets how bright the very brightest parts are.

params.label: Blacks
params.help: Sets how dark the very darkest parts are. Up gives a faded, film look.

params.label: Temperature
params.help: Warm or cool. Right is warmer (orange, sunset), left is cooler (blue, winter).

params.label: Tint
params.help: Fixes or adds a green or pink color cast.

params.label: Saturation
params.help: How strong all colors are. Far left is black and white.

params.label: Vibrance
params.help: Like saturation, but gentle: boosts dull colors more than ones that are already strong. Kind to skin.

params.label: Gamma
params.help: Brightens or darkens the middle tones while leaving pure black and pure white alone.

params.label: Hue shift
params.help: Spins every color around the color wheel: reds become yellows, blues become purples, and so on.

effects.name: Duotone
effects.description: Map shadows and highlights to two colors.
effects.about: Repaints the layer using just two colors: one for dark parts, one for bright parts. A popular poster look.

params.label: Shadows
params.help: The color used for the dark parts.

params.label: Highlights
params.help: The color used for the bright parts.

params.label: Contrast
params.help: How sharply it switches between the two colors. Higher is bolder.

effects.name: Gradient Map
effects.description: Three-color gradient map for shadows, midtones and highlights.
effects.about: Repaints the layer with three colors from dark to bright, like a color gradient laid over the image.

params.label: Shadows
params.help: The color for the darkest parts.

params.label: Midtones
params.help: The color for the in-between tones.

params.label: Highlights
params.help: The color for the brightest parts.

params.label: Midpoint
params.help: Moves where the middle color sits. Lower makes more of the image use the bright colors.

effects.name: Threshold
effects.description: Two-tone cutoff with soft edges.
effects.about: Turns everything into two flat colors, like a stencil or a photocopy.

params.label: Level
params.help: The cut-off point. Parts brighter than this become the light color, darker parts become the dark color.

params.label: Softness
params.help: Smooths the edge between the two colors. 0 is a hard edge.

params.label: Dark
params.help: Color for the dark side.

params.label: Light
params.help: Color for the bright side.

effects.name: Invert & Solarize
effects.description: Invert colors, lightness only, or solarize above a threshold.
effects.about: Flips colors to their opposites, like a photo negative.

params.label: Mode
params.help: Invert RGB flips every color (white↔black, blue↔orange). Invert lightness flips only light and dark but keeps the colors. Solarize flips only the brighter parts, for a trippy darkroom look.

params.label: Solarize at
params.help: For Solarize: how bright a part must be before it gets flipped.

effects.name: Levels
effects.description: Set black point, white point and midtone gamma.
effects.about: Controls exactly how dark the darks and how bright the brights are. Great for fixing washed-out footage.

params.label: Input black
params.help: Anything this dark or darker becomes pure black. Raise it to deepen the shadows.

params.label: Input white
params.help: Anything this bright or brighter becomes pure white. Lower it to make the image brighter and punchier.

params.label: Midtones
params.help: Brightens (above 1) or darkens (below 1) the middle tones only.

params.label: Output black
params.help: The darkest the result is allowed to be. Raise it for a faded, matte look.

params.label: Output white
params.help: The brightest the result is allowed to be. Lower it to tame harsh whites.

effects.name: Chroma Key
effects.description: Remove a green or blue screen, with spill suppression.
effects.about: Removes a green screen (or any solid color background) so you can put something else behind the subject.

params.label: Key color
params.help: The background color to remove. Pick the green (or blue) of your screen.

params.label: Tolerance
params.help: How close a color must be to the key to be removed. Raise it if bits of background remain; lower it if the subject starts disappearing.

params.label: Edge softness
params.help: How soft the cut-out edge is. A little softness hides jagged edges and hair.

params.label: Spill removal
params.help: Removes the green glow that the screen reflects onto the subject's edges and skin.

effects.name: Luma Key
effects.description: Make dark (or bright) areas transparent. Great for fire, smoke and light footage.
effects.about: Makes dark (or bright) parts see-through. Perfect for fire, sparks, smoke or light-leak footage shot on black.

params.label: Remove
params.help: Darks removes dark parts (for footage on black). Brights removes bright parts (for footage on white).

params.label: Level
params.help: How dark (or bright) a part must be to disappear.

params.label: Softness
params.help: How gradually things fade out. Higher keeps soft glows looking natural.

effects.name: Rounded Corners
effects.description: Round any layer with circular or continuous (squircle) corners. Later effects follow the new shape.
effects.about: Rounds off the corners of any layer: photos, videos, shapes. Effects added after this follow the new rounded shape.

params.label: Radius
params.help: How round the corners are.

params.label: Continuous
params.help: Makes corners flow smoothly into the edges, like app icons on an iPhone. 0 is a plain circular corner.

params.label: Feather
params.help: Softens the edges so they fade out instead of being crisp.

params.label: Inset
params.help: Shrinks the layer inward from every side before rounding.

params.label: Top left
params.help: How much of the rounding the top-left corner gets. 0 keeps it square.

params.label: Top right
params.help: How much of the rounding the top-right corner gets. 0 keeps it square.

params.label: Bottom right
params.help: How much of the rounding the bottom-right corner gets. 0 keeps it square.

params.label: Bottom left
params.help: How much of the rounding the bottom-left corner gets. 0 keeps it square.

effects.name: Stroke
effects.description: Outline that follows the exact shape. Stack several for layered outlines.
effects.about: Draws an outline that follows the exact shape of the layer, even text and cut-outs. Add several for layered outlines.

params.label: Width
params.help: How thick the outline is.

params.label: Color
params.help: The outline's color.

params.label: Position
params.help: Outside puts the line around the shape, Inside puts it within the shape, Center straddles the edge.

params.label: Softness
params.help: Blurs the outline into a soft glow-like edge.

params.label: Gap
params.help: Leaves a gap between the shape and the outline.

params.label: Fill
params.help: Keep fill shows the layer plus its outline. Stroke only hides the layer and keeps just the outline.

effects.name: Kaleidoscope
effects.description: Mirror wedges around a center into symmetric patterns.
effects.about: Mirrors slices of the layer around a point, making symmetrical kaleidoscope patterns.

params.label: Segments
params.help: How many mirrored slices. More slices make a busier pattern.

params.label: Rotation
params.help: Turns the whole pattern. Animate it for a spinning kaleidoscope.

params.label: Center
params.help: The middle of the pattern. Drag the dot on the canvas.

params.label: Zoom
params.help: Zooms into the source picture. Bigger shows less of it, more magnified.

params.label: Source offset
params.help: Which part of the layer gets mirrored. Move it to find interesting patterns.

effects.name: Mirror
effects.description: Reflect one side of the layer across a line.
effects.about: Reflects one half of the layer onto the other half, across a line.

params.label: Line point
params.help: A point the mirror line passes through. Drag the dot on the canvas.

params.label: Line angle
params.help: The direction of the mirror line. 90° is a vertical line (left/right mirror); 0° is horizontal (top/bottom mirror).

effects.name: Crop
effects.description: Trim edges non-destructively, with optional feathering. Animate for wipes.
effects.about: Hides the edges of the layer without deleting anything. Animate it for wipe reveals.

params.label: Left
params.help: How much to hide from the left side.

params.label: Right
params.help: How much to hide from the right side.

params.label: Top
params.help: How much to hide from the top.

params.label: Bottom
params.help: How much to hide from the bottom.

params.label: Feather
params.help: Softens the cropped edges so they fade instead of cutting sharply.

effects.name: Fractal Noise
effects.description: Evolving clouds, smoke, marble and turbulence. Domain warp for liquid looks.
effects.about: Creates moving clouds, smoke, marble or liquid textures from scratch. Put it on a solid layer for an instant animated background.

params.label: Scale
params.help: How big the cloud shapes are.

params.label: Detail
params.help: Adds finer and finer layers of detail. Low is soft and blobby, high is crisp and complex.

params.label: Roughness
params.help: How strong the fine details are compared with the big shapes.

params.label: Warp
params.help: Swirls the pattern into itself for liquid, marble-like shapes.

params.label: Contrast
params.help: How strong the difference is between the dark and light parts.

params.label: Brightness
params.help: Makes the whole pattern lighter or darker.

params.label: Evolution
params.help: How fast the pattern changes shape over time. 0 freezes it.

params.label: Drift
params.help: Slides the whole pattern in a direction, like clouds blowing past.

params.label: Dark
params.help: The color of the darkest parts of the pattern.

params.label: Light
params.help: The color of the brightest parts of the pattern.

params.label: Blend
params.help: How the pattern is combined with your layer. Replace shows only the pattern (inside the layer's shape). Over layer puts it on top. Multiply darkens, Screen lightens, Overlay adds contrast.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Gradient
effects.description: Linear, radial or conic gradient, animatable, as a fill or an overlay.
effects.about: Fills the layer with a smooth blend between two colors.

params.label: Type
params.help: Linear goes in a straight line. Radial goes out from the center in circles. Conic sweeps around the center like a clock hand.

params.label: Start
params.help: Where the first color is. Drag the dot on the canvas.

params.label: End
params.help: Where the second color is. Drag the dot on the canvas.

params.label: Start color
params.help: The color at the start point.

params.label: End color
params.help: The color at the end point.

params.label: Midpoint
