params.help: Where the two colors meet half-and-half. Slide it to give one color more room.

params.label: Cycle speed
params.help: Makes the colors flow along the gradient over time. 0 keeps it still.

params.label: Repeat
params.help: What happens past the end points. Clamp keeps the end colors. Mirror bounces back and forth for stripes.

params.label: Blend
params.help: How the pattern is combined with your layer. Replace shows only the pattern (inside the layer's shape). Over layer puts it on top. Multiply darkens, Screen lightens, Overlay adds contrast.

effects.name: Cells
effects.description: Animated Voronoi cells: crystals, organic tissue, stained glass.
effects.about: Draws a pattern of cells, like crystals, cracked earth, giraffe spots or stained glass.

params.label: Cell size
params.help: How big each cell is.

params.label: Style
params.help: Cells fills each cell with a color. Edges draws only the borders. Distance glows toward each cell's center. Stained glass gives each cell its own color with dark lead lines.

params.label: Edge width
params.help: How thick the borders between cells are.

params.label: Motion
params.help: How fast the cells drift and wobble. 0 freezes them.

params.label: Color A
params.help: First color of the pattern.

params.label: Color B
params.help: Second color of the pattern.

params.label: Blend
params.help: How the pattern is combined with your layer. Replace shows only the pattern (inside the layer's shape). Over layer puts it on top. Multiply darkens, Screen lightens, Overlay adds contrast.

effects.name: Overexpose
effects.description: Chemical overexposure: the brightest parts swell and eat the image until it burns to white, leaving only dark edges and fragments. Animate Destruction 0 → 1.
effects.about: Chemical overexposure: the brightest parts swell and eat the picture until it burns to white (or any color), leaving only dark edges and fragments. Animate Destruction from 0 to 100% and back.

params.label: Destruction
params.help: How far the burn has gone. 0 is untouched, 100% is almost entirely white with tiny dark remnants.

params.label: Exposure push
params.help: How much brighter the image gets as Destruction rises.

params.label: Burn threshold
params.help: How bright something must be before it starts to burn away.

params.label: Burn softness
params.help: How soft the edge of the burn is.

params.label: Spread
params.help: How far bright areas reach out and consume their neighbours.

params.label: Burn color
params.help: The color the image burns to. White for a flash, pale cyan for an electric burn.

params.label: Keep dark edges
params.help: How long dark edges and silhouette fragments survive the burn.

params.label: Bleach colors
params.help: How much the colors wash out as they get bright.

params.label: Bloom
params.help: Soft light spilling from the burn.

params.label: Blotchy burn
params.help: Makes the burn blotchy, like overexposed film, instead of even.

params.label: Blotch size
params.help: How big the blotches are.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Solarize
effects.description: Partial tonal inversion: fold the highlights (or the shadows) back around a threshold, so a bright background collapses to dark while edges stay bright.
effects.about: Partial negative: the highlights (or the shadows) fold back around a threshold. A bright background can collapse to near black while bright edges stay bright.

params.label: Threshold
params.help: The brightness where the folding happens.

params.label: Invert highlights
params.help: How much of everything brighter than the threshold flips to dark.

params.label: Invert shadows
params.help: How much of everything darker than the threshold flips to light.

params.label: Curve
params.help: The shape of the fold. Above 1 keeps more of the original near the threshold; below 1 flips harder.

params.label: Blend
params.help: Mix between the original (0%) and the solarized look (100%).

params.label: Works on
params.help: Brightness keeps each color's hue and only flips how light it is. Each color channel flips red, green and blue separately, for wilder color shifts.

params.label: Contrast
params.help: Punch after solarizing.

params.label: Saturation
params.help: How colorful the result is.

effects.name: Poster Palette
effects.description: Screen-print color: brightness bands map to up to seven editable colors (black → midnight → violet → electric blue → cyan → white), as flat bands or smooth, with selective magenta intrusions.
effects.about: Screen-print color: every brightness range gets its own color from a palette of up to seven (deep shadow → shadow → lower mid → mid → upper mid → highlight → extreme highlight), as flat bands or smooth gradients, with optional accent color creeping in.

params.label: Colors used
params.help: How many of the seven palette colors are used.

params.label: Flat bands
params.help: Flat bands (100%) look screen-printed; 0% blends smoothly like a gradient map.

params.label: Contrast
params.help: Spreads the image over more of the palette.

params.label: Shift
params.help: Shifts the whole image toward the dark or light colors.

params.label: Simplify shapes
params.help: Smooths small details first so big areas become solid color.

params.label: Keep shading
params.help: Keeps some of the original shading under the new colors.

params.label: Saturation
params.help: How colorful the result is.

params.label: Deep shadow
params.help: Color for the deepest shadows.

params.label: Shadow
params.help: Color for shadows.

params.label: Lower mid
params.help: Color for the lower midtones.

params.label: Midtone
params.help: Color for the midtones.

params.label: Upper mid
params.help: Color for the upper midtones.

params.label: Highlight
params.help: Color for highlights.

params.label: Extreme highlight
params.help: Color for the very brightest parts.

params.label: Deep shadow at
params.help: Where the deep-shadow color starts (brightness).

params.label: Shadow at
params.help: Where the shadow color starts.

params.label: Lower mid at
params.help: Where the lower-mid color starts.

params.label: Midtone at
params.help: Where the midtone color starts.

params.label: Upper mid at
params.help: Where the upper-mid color starts.

params.label: Highlight at
params.help: Where the highlight color starts.

params.label: Extreme highlight at
params.help: Where the extreme-highlight color starts.

params.label: Intrusion color
params.help: An accent color that creeps into chosen parts of the image (magenta or pink by default).

params.label: Amount
params.help: How strongly the accent color takes over where it appears.

params.label: Where
params.help: Where the accent appears: where the source was red or pink, in the most colorful areas, in shadows, in highlights, or in drifting noise patches.

params.label: Range
params.help: How much of the image counts (wider or narrower selection).

params.label: Patch size
params.help: Size of the noise patches.

params.label: Patch drift
params.help: How fast the noise patches drift.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Posterize Pro
effects.description: Illustrated, screen-printed tones: separate levels for brightness and color (or each RGB channel), edge-preserving smoothing so big shapes stay recognizable, soft band edges, optional outlines, and steady bands on video.
effects.about: Cuts the image into a few flat tones so it looks illustrated, with separate controls for brightness and color, smoothing that keeps big shapes recognizable, and bands that stay steady on video.

params.label: Levels for
params.help: Brightness + color quantizes lightness and color separately (keeps hues natural). Each RGB channel quantizes red, green and blue separately (more graphic color shifts).

params.label: Brightness levels
params.help: How many brightness steps remain.

params.label: Color levels
params.help: How many color steps remain. Low numbers make colors flat and bold.

params.label: Red levels
params.help: How many steps of red remain.

params.label: Green levels
params.help: How many steps of green remain.

params.label: Blue levels
params.help: How many steps of blue remain.

params.label: Smooth regions
params.help: Smooths textures inside areas first so they become clean flat shapes.

params.label: Edge preservation
params.help: How well the smoothing respects outlines. High keeps silhouettes sharp.

params.label: Band softness
params.help: Soft or hard steps between bands.

params.label: Steady on video
params.help: On video: keeps each pixel on its band unless it really changes, so bands don't flicker.

params.label: Band outlines
params.help: Draws thin lines where bands meet, like an illustration.

params.label: Outline color
params.help: Color of those lines.

effects.name: Print Texture
effects.description: Imperfect printing: rough and eroded edges, ink spread, blotchy ink density, missing-ink specks and toner dots, grain, and a misregistered color plate. Strongest on black areas and type.
effects.about: Imperfect printing: rough eroded edges, ink spreading, blotchy ink, missing-ink specks and toner dots, grain, and a color plate printed slightly off. Strongest on black areas and type.

params.label: Print roughness
params.help: How ragged every edge becomes.

params.label: Edge erosion
params.help: Eats into the edges of ink, making shapes thinner and broken.

params.label: Ink spread
params.help: Ink bleeds outward, making shapes fatter.

params.label: Ink density variation
params.help: Uneven ink: big soft lighter patches in dark areas.

params.label: Registration error
params.help: How far the color plate is printed off from the black plate.

params.label: Registration direction
params.help: Which way the color plate is off.

params.label: Speckle
params.help: Tiny missing-ink specks in dark areas and stray toner dots in light ones.

params.label: Toner grain
params.help: Fine toner grain.

params.label: Texture scale
params.help: Size of the grain and specks.

params.label: Paper color
params.help: The paper color that shows through missing ink.

params.label: Boil
params.help: Re-prints the texture this many times per second (0 keeps it still and steady).

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Luma Reveal
effects.description: Reveal (or wipe away) the layer by its own brightness: bright parts first or dark parts first, broken up by noise, with an optional glowing burn edge. Animate Progress 0 → 1.
effects.about: Reveals the layer by its own brightness: bright parts appear first (or dark parts first), broken up by noise, with an optional glowing burn edge. Animate Progress from 0 to 100%.

params.label: Progress
params.help: 0% hides everything, 100% shows everything.

params.label: Order
params.help: Whether bright or dark areas appear first.

params.label: Threshold feather
params.help: How soft the reveal edge is.

params.label: Noise modulation
params.help: Mixes in noise so the reveal is organic rather than following brightness exactly.

params.label: Noise size
params.help: Size of the noise.

params.label: Noise motion
params.help: Makes the noise move while revealing.

params.label: Edge width
params.help: A glowing band right at the reveal edge. 0 turns it off.

params.label: Edge color
params.help: Color of that band.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Displace
effects.description: Small, art-directed distortion: turbulence, a push along one direction, shifted scanlines, brightness-driven offsets or jumping blocks. Can step at a low frame rate. Use the effect field "Inside masks" for mask-driven displacement.
effects.about: Small, controlled distortion for chaotic moments: turbulence, a push in one direction, shifted scanlines, brightness-driven offsets or jumping blocks. Can update at a low frame rate for a choppy feel.

params.label: Type
params.help: The kind of distortion.

params.label: Amount
params.help: How far pixels move. Keep it small so things stay readable.

params.label: Size
params.help: Size of the distortion pattern.

params.label: Direction
params.help: Direction for Directional, Scanlines and By brightness.

params.label: Speed
params.help: How fast it changes.

params.label: Step rate
params.help: Updates this many times per second (0 = smooth). Low numbers give jumpy, stepped motion.

params.label: Sparse
params.help: How few lines or blocks are affected.

params.label: Detail
params.help: More layers of finer detail in the noise.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Camera Impact
effects.description: The frame gets hit: a quick scale punch, a few frames of shake and a tiny rotation that settle. Put it on an adjustment layer and set when the hit lands (seconds after the layer starts).
effects.about: The frame gets hit: a quick zoom punch, a few frames of shake and a tiny tilt that settle. Put it on an adjustment layer above everything and set when the hit lands.

params.label: Hit at
params.help: When the hit lands, in seconds after this layer starts.

params.label: Scale punch
params.help: How much the frame zooms in on the hit.

params.label: Shake
params.help: How far it shakes.

params.label: Rotation
params.help: How much it tilts.

params.label: Settle time
params.help: How long until it calms down.

params.label: Shake speed
params.help: How fast it shakes.

params.label: Repeat every
params.help: Hit again every this many seconds (0 = once).

params.label: Edges
params.help: What shows at the frame edges while shaking.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Frame Echo
effects.description: Silhouettes from earlier frames, each offset and tinted (purple, then magenta…), like misregistered print layers rather than motion blur. Works on video and on adjustment layers; needs playback (echoes rebuild after a seek).
effects.about: Shows silhouettes from a few frames ago, each offset and tinted (purple, then magenta), like misregistered print layers. Use it on video or on an adjustment layer; echoes appear while playing and rebuild after you jump in time.

params.label: Echo frames
params.help: How many earlier frames are shown.

params.label: Frame offset
params.help: How many frames apart the echoes are.

params.label: Spatial offset
params.help: How far each echo is shifted.

params.label: Offset direction
params.help: Which way the echoes are shifted.

params.label: Echo 1 color
params.help: Color of the nearest echo.

params.label: Echo 2 color
params.help: Color of the second echo.

params.label: Echo 3+ color
params.help: Color of the third and fourth echoes.

params.label: Silhouette
params.help: 100% turns echoes into solid-colored silhouettes; 0% keeps their real colors.

params.label: Opacity
params.help: How strong the echoes are.

params.label: Opacity decay
params.help: How much weaker each older echo gets.

params.label: Echo
params.help: Echo the whole layer shape, or only its bright parts (for full-frame video).

params.label: Brightness threshold
params.help: For Bright areas: how bright a part must be to echo.

params.label: Place
params.help: Behind puts echoes under the layer; Screen and Add put light echoes on top.

effects.name: Particle Field
effects.description: Dust, stars and print speckle in clusters: points, little crosses, 4-point stars and scratches. Some stay put, some drift, some flicker and a few shoot across. Put it on a solid with "Particles only" for an overlay.
effects.about: A field of tiny luminous things in clusters: points, little crosses, 4-point stars and scratches. Some stay still, some drift, some flicker and a few shoot across. Put it on a solid with "Particles only" to lay it over everything.

params.label: Density
params.help: How many particles.

params.label: Clustering
params.help: How much they bunch into clusters instead of spreading evenly.

params.label: Cluster size
params.help: Size of the clusters.

params.label: Spacing
params.help: Minimum spacing between particles.

params.label: Size
params.help: Particle size.

params.label: Size variation
params.help: How different the sizes are.

params.label: Color
params.help: Main particle color.

params.label: Second color
params.help: Second particle color.

params.label: Second color share
params.help: How many particles use the second color.

params.label: Crosses
params.help: Share of little crosses.

params.label: Stars
params.help: Share of 4-point stars.

params.label: Scratches
params.help: Share of short scratches.

params.label: Drift
params.help: How fast the drifting particles move.

params.label: Drift direction
params.help: Which way they drift.

params.label: Fixed share
params.help: Share of particles that stay still.

params.label: Shooting
params.help: How many fast shooting streaks there are.

params.label: Shoot speed
params.help: How fast they shoot.

params.label: Shoot direction
params.help: Which way they shoot.

params.label: Flicker
params.help: How much particles flicker on and off.

params.label: Flicker rate
params.help: How often they flicker.

params.label: Glow
params.help: Soft glow around each particle.

params.label: Brightness
params.help: Overall brightness.

params.label: Blend
params.help: Particles only makes everything else see-through. Add and Screen put them over the layer.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

effects.name: Star Glints
effects.description: Small 4-, 6- or 8-point star highlights that pop on the brightest spots: celestial sparkle on bright lines, letters and edges.
effects.about: Small 4-, 6- or 8-point star highlights that pop on the brightest spots: celestial sparkle on bright lines, letters and edges.

params.label: Brightness needed
params.help: How bright a spot must be to get a star.

params.label: Points
params.help: Number of points on each star.

params.label: Ray length
params.help: How long the rays are.

params.label: Ray thickness
params.help: How thick the rays are.

params.label: Intensity
params.help: How bright the stars are.

params.label: Glow
params.help: Soft glow around each star.

params.label: Rotation
params.help: Turns the stars.

params.label: Spin
params.help: Keeps the stars turning (degrees per second).

params.label: Flicker
params.help: How much they twinkle.

params.label: Spacing
params.help: Spacing: at most one star per area this big.

params.label: How many
params.help: How many eligible spots actually get a star.

params.label: Tint
params.help: Star color. At 0% opacity each star takes the color of its spot.

params.label: Seed
params.help: A different random starting point. Same look, different arrangement. Try a few numbers until you like it.

transitions.name: Optical Flare
transitions.description: A bright anamorphic lens flare sweeps across and flashes the cut.

params.label: Flare color
params.help: The color of the flare light.

params.label: Intensity
params.help: How bright the flare gets.

params.label: Streak length
params.help: How long the horizontal light streak is.

params.label: Angle
params.help: Tilts the streak.

params.label: Height
params.help: How high up on the screen the flare travels.

params.label: Ghosts
params.help: The little colored circles a real lens adds along the flare.

params.label: Rainbow halo
params.help: A faint rainbow ring around the flare.

params.label: Flash
params.help: How much the whole screen flashes at the cut.

params.label: Bloom
params.help: How much the picture blooms and glows during the flare.

params.label: Sweep
params.help: Which way the flare travels, or burst from the middle.

params.label: Easing
params.help: How the transition speeds up and slows down.

transitions.name: Match-Cut Morph
transitions.description: The first shape melts into the second: outlines morph, textures stretch to follow, colors cross over.

params.label: Texture warp
params.help: How much each picture stretches to follow the morphing outline.

params.label: Edge softness
params.help: How soft the morphing outline is.

params.label: Motion blur
params.help: Motion blur in the middle of the morph.

params.label: Zoom punch
params.help: A small zoom that pushes into the cut.

params.label: Edge glow
params.help: A glowing rim on the morphing outline.

params.label: Glow color
params.help: The color of that rim.

params.label: Easing
params.help: How the morph speeds up and slows down.

transitions.name: Dither Dissolve
transitions.description: Pixels flip from the first picture to the second in a dithered pattern, with a glowing edge.

params.label: Pixel size
params.help: How big the switching pixels are.

params.label: Pattern
params.help: The order pixels switch in.

params.label: Edge glow
params.help: Glow where pixels are switching.

params.label: Edge color
params.help: Color of that glow.

params.label: Easing
params.help: Speed curve of the dissolve.

transitions.name: Zoom Through
transitions.description: Punches into the first picture with a zoom blur and out of the second.

params.label: Zoom
params.help: How far it zooms.

params.label: Center
params.help: The point it zooms into. Drag the dot on the canvas.

params.label: Easing
params.help: Speed curve of the zoom.

transitions.name: Whip Pan
transitions.description: A fast camera whip: the first picture smears off-screen and the second smears in.

params.label: Direction
params.help: Which way the camera whips.

params.label: Smear
params.help: How much motion smear.

params.label: Easing
params.help: Speed curve of the whip.

transitions.name: Ink Wipe
transitions.description: An organic, noisy edge wipes the second picture over the first, like spreading ink or burning paper.

params.label: Blot size
params.help: How big the blotches in the edge are.

params.label: Edge width
params.help: How thick the glowing edge is.

params.label: Edge color
params.help: The color of the edge.

params.label: From
params.help: Where the wipe starts.

params.label: Easing
params.help: Speed curve of the wipe.

textAnimations.name: Bounce in
textAnimations.description: Letters drop in one by one and bounce on landing.

textAnimations.name: Pop in
textAnimations.description: Each letter pops up from nothing with a springy overshoot.

textAnimations.name: Fade up
textAnimations.description: Letters rise gently into place while fading in.

textAnimations.name: Typewriter
textAnimations.description: Letters appear one at a time, like typing.

textAnimations.name: Decode
textAnimations.description: Random characters flicker and lock into the real text, like a code being cracked.

textAnimations.name: Spin in
textAnimations.description: Letters spin and grow into place.

textAnimations.name: Slide in
textAnimations.description: Letters slide in from the left and fade up.

textAnimations.name: Tracking in
textAnimations.description: Letters start spread wide apart and glide together (a cinematic title classic).

textAnimations.name: Word drop
textAnimations.description: Whole words drop in from above, one after another.

textAnimations.name: Flicker on
textAnimations.description: Letters flicker on like a neon sign warming up.

textAnimations.name: Write on
textAnimations.description: Each letter is written from left to right, like a quick hand with a pen. Great with script fonts.

textAnimations.name: Outline draw
textAnimations.description: The outline of each letter traces itself like a pen, then the letter fills in. For full control (keyframed progress, order, wobble), use Outline drawing in the Text tab.

textAnimations.name: Fade down
textAnimations.description: Letters sink and fade away one by one.

textAnimations.name: Scatter
textAnimations.description: Letters fly apart in random directions, spinning as they fade.

textAnimations.name: Fall away
textAnimations.description: Letters fall off the screen as if gravity just switched on.

textAnimations.name: Wave
textAnimations.description: Letters ripple up and down in a continuous wave.

textAnimations.name: Hop
textAnimations.description: Letters take turns hopping up.

textAnimations.name: Swing
textAnimations.description: Letters rock back and forth.

textAnimations.name: Jitter
textAnimations.description: Letters shake nervously in random little jumps.

textAnimations.name: Rainbow
textAnimations.description: Colors flow through the letters in a rainbow.

textAnimations.name: Flicker
textAnimations.description: Random letters dim and flicker like a failing sign.

looks.name: Blueprint

looks.name: Chroma

looks.name: Ember

looks.name: Inferno

looks.name: ASCII

looks.name: Cosmos

looks.name: Outline

looks.description: PICO-8 colors on a glowing curved arcade tube.

looks.name: Game Boy

looks.name: Matrix Code

looks.name: Comic Print

looks.name: Boss Title · Gold
looks.description: A golden dithered gradient in the letters, glowing softly, revealed through a dither wipe while the letters drift together.

looks.name: Boss Title · Crimson
looks.description: Blood-red dithered type with dark vignette glow, swept in from the left.

looks.name: Boss Title · Moonlit
looks.description: Pale blue-silver dithered letters that shimmer like cold moonlight.

looks.name: Boss Backdrop
looks.description: For the footage behind a title: darkens it, adds a dithered grade and vignette so the title pops.

looks.name: Boss Title · Traced Outline
looks.description: Giant outlined name whose letters trace themselves like a pen in random order, then a cyan glow and print grit. (For full control, use Outline drawing in the Text tab.)

looks.name: Boss Poster · Screen Print
looks.description: Turns footage into a screen-printed poster: the background folds to near black, colors snap to cyan, blue and violet bands with magenta intrusions, outlines glow, then dither and print grit.

looks.name: Boss Flash · White-out
looks.description: The image chemically burns to white and comes back: highlights swell and eat everything, dark fragments survive, then it rebuilds. Put it on an adjustment layer at the moment of the reveal.

looks.name: Boss Flash · Cyan Burn

looks.name: Chromatic Glass

looks.name: Liquid Chrome

looks.name: Neon Sign

looks.name: Heavenly
